f.title: Identify whether you are a combination product applicant or a constituent part applicant
f.statement: A combination product applicant is an applicant that holds the application(s) for a combination product. A constituent part applicant is the applicant for a constituent part of a combination product whose constituent parts are marketed under applications held by different applicants. An applicant is a person holding an application (BLA, NDA, ANDA or device application, including amendments and supplements) under which a combination product or constituent part has received marketing authorization.
